meta.status: complete draft: floors L0-L6 built and linked

conventions.uncertain: true means read from the map with low confidence; verify on site
conventions.room_attachment: rooms attach to the nearest corridor node; door positions are not drawn on the maps
conventions.ids: corridor/room/restroom ids are <floor>_<local>; stairs/elevators/exits are <kind>_<n>_<floor> so the same stair links across floors
conventions.upper_floors: L3-L6 share one ring-corridor template (13 nodes); L6 replaces the north corridor with room 606 as a passage. L2 uses coarse open-area zones, not corridors. Exit arrows on L2-L6 are stair entries, so there are no exit nodes there.
conventions.poster_frame: L0 and L1 posters have north at the top of the page. L2-L6 posters have north pointing RIGHT (the compass on each poster), so they are drawn rotated 90 degrees. Node LABELS on every floor use COMPASS directions. Node IDS on L2-L6 keep the poster's PAGE directions (nw, ne, n, e, s, w in ids such as L3_c_nw_lobby, L3_c_s_stair) so scenarios and tests keep working. Page-to-compass on L2-L6: page top = west, page right = north, page bottom = east, page left = south, so a page-frame id suffix nw is compass SW, ne is NW, se is NE, sw is SE. To draw north-up, rotate an L2-L6 poster 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
